## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes (`-m "not slow"` if you don't have LibreOffice)
- [ ] `ruff check src tests` and `ruff format --check src tests` are clean
- [ ] `mypy src` is clean
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed — `README.md` **and** `README.tr.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] New behaviour has a test
